proposals.evidence: DEDR 3178 full article (p. 276) gives 3178 Ta. tār̤ (-v-, -nt-) to fall low, be lowered, be low (as a roof), flow down, descend, decline as the sun, sink in water, sink in circumstances or repute, decrease, decay, degenerate, de Bhat dāŋgɨ “to bend” matches Lindgren Koraga daŋgɨ “bend” in form and sense; this cross-source match is a candidate lead, with the full DEDR article defining the family. Both source identities and dialect tags are preserved.
